seo.title: Your Company — car rental in Tashkent with delivery
seo.description: Rent a car from a day to a month: Cobalt, Malibu, K5, Tucson, Camry, Carnival minivan. Delivery to your door and the airport, insurance included, paperwork in 15 minutes.
seo.answer: Your Company is a car rental company in Tashkent: Chevrolet Cobalt from 350,000 UZS a day, Toyota Camry from 900,000 UZS, Kia Carnival minivan from 1,200,000 UZS. You need a passport and a licence held for at least 2 years, minimum age 21; delivery in the city is free for rentals of 3 days or more, to the airport 100,000 UZS.

listing.description: A website for car rental, car sharing or transfers. A studio scene with a car on the move, the fleet as a strip of spec cards with a daily price, rates by rental length and a rental route with a little car driving along it.

business.areaServed: Tashkent, Islam Karimov airport, trips across Uzbekistan

items.title: Booking
items.text: Choose a car and dates — leave a request or message us on Telegram.

items.text: Send photos of your passport and licence — we check them in 10 minutes.

items.text: We bring the car to your home or the airport and sign the contract on the spot.

items.title: Return
items.text: Leave the car wherever suits you — we collect it and return your deposit.

items.quote: We landed at night and got the car right at the terminal exit. Twenty minutes later we were driving to the hotel.
items.author: Alexey

items.quote: We took the Carnival for a week for a family trip to Samarkand. The car was clean and the child seats were already fitted.
items.author: Nodira

items.a: A passport and a category B driving licence held for at least 2 years. Foreign visitors need a passport and a national licence with an international driving permit.
Yes, a refundable deposit from 1,000,000 UZS depending on the car class. It is returned on the day you hand the car back, after inspection.
Third-party and comprehensive cover are included. The comprehensive excess is from 2,000,000 UZS and can be reduced to zero for an extra fee.
Yes, anywhere in Uzbekistan. Tell us the route when booking and we'll issue a power of attorney. Driving abroad is not allowed.
Within Tashkent it's free for rentals of 3 days or more, otherwise 50,000 UZS. To the airport — 100,000 UZS at any time.

items.q: What if the car breaks down?
items.a: Call the dispatcher: in the city we replace the car within 2 hours; outside the city we send a tow truck and a replacement.

sections.label: Booking
sections.title: Where should we bring the car?
sections.text: Send the dates, the car class and the delivery address — we'll confirm the booking within 10 minutes.
